list.title: Meetings
list.subtitle: Recorded conversations, transcribed and turned into action items
list.empty_description: Record a conversation and Multica transcribes it as it runs, writes a summary, and queues every action item in Triage.

capability.title: Transcription is not configured
capability.description: This server has no speech-to-text provider, so meetings cannot be recorded yet.

detail.summary_unavailable: No summary was written: the transcript was kept, but no language model was available.
detail.summary_stalled: Summary is taking longer than expected. The run that was writing it is gone — regenerate it to try again.

recorder.title: Recording
recorder.consent: Let participants know this meeting is being transcribed.
recorder.mic_only: System audio was not shared, so only the microphone is recorded.
recorder.error_microphone: Microphone access was refused, so recording cannot start.
recorder.error_segment: A segment could not be transcribed.
recorder.error_not_recording: This meeting is no longer recording.
recorder.error_too_long: The meeting reached its maximum length and was stopped.
recorder.error_stt: Transcription is not configured on this server.
recorder.elsewhere: This meeting is being recorded from another device or tab.
recorder.orphaned: This recording was interrupted (the page was closed or refreshed). Close the meeting to summarize what was transcribed so far.
recorder.live_lost: The live transcript dropped. The recording continues and each segment is transcribed when it ends.

detected.description: {{appName}} is using the microphone. Take notes?

delete_dialog.title: Delete “{{title}}”?
delete_dialog.body: The recording and its transcript are removed for good. Action items already queued in Triage are kept.
